orders_fulfilment_destination.name: orders_fulfilment_destination
orders_fulfilment_destination.value:
case when "orders"."fulfilmentMethod" = 'delivery'
        then "orders"."deliveryStreet" is not null
          and "orders"."deliveryPostalCode" is not null
          and "orders"."deliveryCity" is not null
          and "orders"."deliveryCountry" is not null
          and "orders"."pickupLocationKey" is null
        else "orders"."pickupLocationKey" is not null
          and "orders"."deliveryStreet" is null
        end

products_low_stock_threshold_positive.name: products_low_stock_threshold_positive
products_low_stock_threshold_positive.value:
"products"."lowStockThresholdPieces" is null
        or ("products"."lowStockThresholdPieces" >= 1 and "products"."stockPieces" is not null)

products_units_positive.name: products_units_positive
products_units_positive.value:
"products"."priceBasisPieces" >= 1 and "products"."minPieceQty" >= 1
        and "products"."boxCount" >= 1
        and ("products"."piecesPerPack" is null or "products"."piecesPerPack" >= 1)
        and ("products"."packsPerBox" is null or "products"."packsPerBox" >= 1)

products_box_needs_pack.name: products_box_needs_pack
products_box_needs_pack.value: "products"."packsPerBox" is null or "products"."piecesPerPack" is not null

products_basis_divides_quantities.name: products_basis_divides_quantities
products_basis_divides_quantities.value:
"products"."minPieceQty" % "products"."priceBasisPieces" = 0
        and ("products"."piecesPerPack" is null
             or "products"."piecesPerPack" % "products"."priceBasisPieces" = 0)
        and ("products"."piecesPerPack" is null
             or "products"."minPieceQty" >= "products"."piecesPerPack"
             or "products"."priceBasisPieces" = 1)
